rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２１Good morning.￥Mind if I come in for a moment?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２２I'll get right to the point...＝＠１５９＿０２６Lately, you've been neglecting￥your Tech training.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２４At this rate, you'll fall too￥far behind the other candidates.＝＠１５９＿０２７I've opened up the Maintenance￥Room system for you, so let's do￥some extra training together.
